issues.description: The solution groups rows by 'kreis' but selects 'regierungsbezirk' without aggregating or grouping by it, which contradicts the problem text that asks for sums grouped by Regierungsbezirk. This produces an invalid/ambiguous SQL query and will confuse students about which column to group by.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution to group by 'regierungsbezirk' (e.g. GROUP BY regierungsbezirk) so that the SELECT list only contains grouped columns and aggregates, matching the problem requirement. Alternatively, if grouping by county ('kreis') was intended, update the problem statement to request grouping by 'kreis' and adjust the SELECT accordingly.
